en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a long, grand neoclassical building on a wide street, with bare trees lining the sidewalk and a horse‑drawn carriage at the far left. The façade has arched windows on the ground floor, rectangular windows above, and a central section with large columns and sculptural figures on the pediment. There is a narrow decorative border around the photograph and handwritten cursive text along the right margin, dated 1904.
